name: Banni Grasslands
description: Arid grassland and seasonal wetland landscape of Kutch district, Gujarat, India. The default analysis geometry is the rectangular window used by the research handover; it is NOT the grassland boundary (see geometry notes).

events.name: Cyclone Biparjoy landfall
events.note: Landfall near Jakhau, Kutch (date per public reports; verify before publication).

geometry.source: Banni Project handover (pp.1, 5, 10): every script uses ee.Geometry.Rectangle([68.80,23.20,69.95,23.95])

reference_area_note: The handover labels this box '~2,618 sq km', but its computed area is ~9,751 km2, so the label cannot describe the box. Published figures for the Banni grassland itself are of the same order as 2,618 km2 (see published_area_figures), so 2,618 km2 most plausibly refers to the grassland extent. Handover results were computed over the rectangle, not the grassland.
